purpose: Bind every model used by the 14-method Mem-Gallery static track before data materialization, lifecycle execution, or score observation, while reusing already frozen cross-track assets where method fidelity permits.

models.role: matched answer model and method-internal LLM for every method that requires generation, routing, extraction, reflection, or memory mutation
matched OpenAI-compatible text embedding endpoint for M2A and custom dense controls where the method does not prescribe a different encoder
official Mem-Gallery joint encoder for NaiveRAG, NGM, AUGUSTUS, and UniversalRAG
models.reuse_policy: Use the exact WMA Wave-2 materialization; do not create a duplicate snapshot.

models.role: official/default text encoder for A-MEM, MemoryOS, and V-Mem
models.reuse_policy: Use the exact WMA Wave-3 materialization; do not create a duplicate snapshot.

models.role: method-prescribed 768-dimensional image and text encoder for V-Mem visual lanes and M2A multimodal embeddings
models.ownership_gate: A successor ownership ledger must add this exact target and all M2A/V-Mem dependents before materialization.

execution_order: Wait for the WMA Wave-1 controller, all of its child processes, and all three current model services to stop.
Accept the frozen Mem-Gallery dataset materialization and semantic integrity audit.
Materialize the already frozen GME and MiniLM snapshots through their existing zero-retry materializers.
Freeze and accept a successor ownership ledger plus an exact zero-retry SigLIP2 materializer before downloading SigLIP2.
Hash-inventory each model and force offline loading before method lifecycle execution.
failure_rule: Any revision, file name, byte count, security status, target, ownership, symlink, or post-download hash mismatch yields a retained terminal rejection in a fresh root. No method may silently fall back to a network model or another encoder.
explicitly_prohibited: downloading or serving a new model while WMA Wave 1 is active
substituting the shared Qwen embedding model for V-Mem SigLIP2 and calling it a V-Mem reproduction
creating duplicate GME or MiniLM snapshots instead of reusing the frozen cross-track targets
materializing SigLIP2 before a successor ownership ledger covers it
deleting any model through the v1 cleanup entrypoint or before all three comparison tracks are complete
